## Devils en Pointe presents Tchaikovsky's *The Nutcracker*

DEP's 2025 performance of *The Nutcracker* is the first time live dance ever made me mist up, so you've gotta go:

- Wednesday December 2 at 7:00 pm;
- Thursday December 3 at 7:00 pm;
- Reynolds Theater (Bryan Center);
- [@devilsenpointe](https://www.instagram.com/devilsenpointe/?hl=en).
